title: The Private Reading & Audio Sanctuary: listen, read, and write

intro.headline: Private audiobooks, distraction-free reading, and encrypted notes.
intro.subhead: Audiobookshelf, KOReader, and Notesnook replace Audible, Kindle, and Evernote with community-owned sovereignty.

outro.headline: Your media and thoughts belong to you.
outro.subhead: No revoked Kindle licenses, no subscription paywalls on your books, and no server snooping on your personal journals.
